title: National Certified Nurse-Midwife (CNM) 50-State & DC Workforce Registry
version_note: The latest git tag (v0.7.0, 2026-08-13). This file said 4.0.0 until 2026-09-13; no such version was ever tagged. Cite a commit SHA for later work.
description: The American Midwifery Certification Board roster linked to CMS NPPES for NPI identity and practice geography, with Doctors & Clinicians, Open Payments and Census geography layers. State Board of Nursing licensure is observed only for Washington, Colorado and Texas, from each board's open data. Every count below is read from the tracked artifact named in cohort_statistics_sources; tests/test_midwifery_pipeline.py fails if they disagree.

author.name: Dr. Tyler Muffly, MD
author.affiliation: Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Denver Health and Hospital Authority, Denver, Colorado, USA

cohort_statistics_sources.board_licences_returned: docs/figures/board_licensure_observed_counts.csv: sum of n where outcome starts "Licence returned", by state

retracted: Until 2026-09-13 this file reported total_active_amcb_cnms and nppes_npi_matched = 12211 with npi_match_rate_pct 100.0 (12,211 was the row count of a file holding 11,920 certificants; the 100% was typed), 374 board-verified licences (Washington only, 368 people), and 5,024 CPT delivery attenders (a relabelled DAC specialty flag; public Part B has no delivery-code rows). See NEWS.md and docs/PROVENANCE_DEFECT_BON_LICENSE_IDENTIFIERS.md.
